display.title: Create: The Brass Age
display.subtitle: Produce Brass
description: Brass unlocks Create's advanced tier — Mechanical Arms, Deployers, the
Mechanical Crafter array. Smelt zinc + copper in a heated mixer (the Blaze
Burner is pre-fuelled to Tier 1 here) to pour your first brass.
§7Andesite Alloy and brass are bread-and-butter Engineering tokens.
